test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, “QUOTE” is written as “RWRXJ”, and “UNION” is written as “VPLSS”. How will “YOUNG” be written in that language?
solution:
**Explanation :**

The table of alphabet positional value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af9cfa35a1b8810e38328421bfbd33050c32de331085ef6af8fde345c735089f.png] 

According to positional value

QUOTE is written as RWRXJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3443cad9587d331739bd18b04d5416acb335aa9005c4b0b68c040237a43427f.png] 

In the same way, UNION is written as VPLSS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f22560531d4075964bf432821671f591b02d9d4a17b8b000f88eda4a9cb59ea1.png] 

Similarly, “YOUNG” is written as "ZQXRL"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fce42e55c67240823e10a56f1b1c8db7e80dec95c94b22615f13551c1b863b8.png] 

Hence, **ZQXRL **is the **correct answer.**
